For her outfit, aim for a “tighter” look with an “off the shoulder” design, a “sweetheart” neckline, and a short ruffled skirt. Use soft pink, soft blue, and deep purples. Add 1 thigh-high stocking and detailed shoes.

Include “Emblems” or “Motifs” related to sleep & dreams on the outfit, stocking, shoes, and choker.

With a simple forward-facing pose, two highlight colors in her hair on top of the base hair color, and a gentle, curious expression.
